LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for British Columbia

Visitors aged 16 and older need a provincial freshwater licence. Tidal waters require a separate federal licence at every age.

  • April 1 to March 31$62.87 CAD
  • April 1 to March 31$91.44 CAD
  • 1 day$22.86 CAD
  • 8 days$41.15 CAD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Tidal salmon conservation stamp ↗ · $7.39 CAD
    Every angler who keeps salmon from tidal water. Add the stamp to the federal tidal fishing licence.

Rules for this water

  • For tidal salmon, use barbless single-point hooks; the maximum hook gap is 22 mm from September 1, 2026.
  • Use DFO Area 13 limits and closure maps for the actual fishing position official regulations ↗

Full British Columbia licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
